ENABLED_SUBTITLE: Show a status of your choice after you stop using Discord.
TARGET_STATUS_SUBTITLE: What to show once you are idle.
IDLE_DELAY_SUBTITLE: How long Discord must be idle before the status applies.
ONLY_BACKGROUNDED: Only while Discord is in the background
ONLY_BACKGROUNDED_SUBTITLE: Leave your status alone while you are looking at Discord.
NOT_IN_VOICE: Skip while in a voice call
NOT_IN_VOICE_SUBTITLE: Being in a call counts as activity, so no idle status.
EXCLUDE_ACTIVITY_SUBTITLE: A game or activity counts as activity, so no idle status.
RESET_ON_MESSAGE: Reset when you send a message
RESET_ON_MESSAGE_SUBTITLE: Sending a message counts as activity and restarts the delay.
ACTIVE_HOURS_SUBTITLE: Only apply the idle status inside this window.
ACTIVE_HOURS_ENABLED_SUBTITLE: Turn on to limit idle to a time window.
QUIET_HOURS_SUBTITLE: A window that applies its own status at once.
QUIET_HOURS_ENABLED_SUBTITLE: Turn on to force a status during certain hours.
QUIET_STATUS_SUBTITLE: The status quiet hours applies, ignoring the idle delay.
